objective: Build one cheaper directly executable Kimi derivative and test the >=150 generated TPS target without touching KIMI_P0_OPERATIONAL.

control.capability: existing KIMI_P0_OPERATIONAL worker envelope; candidate must be compared, never self-certified

gravity_reuse.architecture: DeepSeek-V2-style MLA plus 64 routed experts, top-6 routed and 2 shared
gravity_reuse.registry_boundary: PROVEN_FLASH_SCOPED; not transferred as a live Kimi route/capability claim
gravity_reuse.reason: Existing Kimi receipts already show these families either fail capability or lose physical performance.

recipe_observed.boundary: Built-in mlx_vlm mixed_4_8 predicate; most attention and shared-expert projections are q4, so this is not an all-sensitive-islands-protected claim.

gpu_attempt.error: Metal command-buffer execution timed out while P0/U001 were resident

conversion.claim_boundary: Artifact identity and byte accounting are verified; runtime throughput and capability remain unqualified.

static_accounting.method: q8 safetensors headers; q4 changes packed weight payload only; scales and biases billed unchanged
static_accounting.claim_boundary: static estimate reconciled to CPU conversion output; resident size and TPS remain runtime measurements

active_traffic_estimate.method: one decode token: six of 64 routed experts plus both shared experts; all other per-token weight arrays counted once
active_traffic_estimate.claim_boundary: static weight-read estimate; not measured GPU traffic or TPS

protected_boundary.reason: P0 and KIMI-U001 remain live on port 8014. P1 conversion completed CPU-only; P1 runtime may share GPU by explicit user authorization, but P0 remains the immutable rollback control.

runtime_measurement.claim_boundary: P1 is a measured staging resident, not a qualified Kimi worker or promotion candidate. P0 remains the control.

capability_smoke.claim_boundary: Three short endpoint smoke cases only; this does not replace the existing P0 capability, authorization, epistemic, or HCLI batteries.

disposition.reason: The built-in mixed_4_8 recipe reduced resident bytes but measured 56.4-75.9 decode TPS, below both the >=150 target and the shared-GPU P0 control. Its broad q4 coverage includes most attention/shared-expert projections, so the result does not establish a routed-expert-only traffic win.
disposition.next_frontier: Do not run another quantization permutation. A native route-major q4/g64 gate_up+down consumer with persistent buffers is the only remaining credible Kimi-specific physical path; otherwise return the GPU to Flash/Pulsar source-bound work.

next_safe_action: Keep P0 on port 8014 and KIMI-U001 live. Preserve P1/P2/P4/P5 artifacts and receipts. Do not spend another GPU window on a quantization permutation; only a native route-major consumer merits reopening this tranche.
